text:
Noel Kim: hey everyone :wave: i’m Noel — started today on product design, remote from portland. quick heads up: i have a corgi (Pickles :dog:) who may appear on video calls and i play ukulele badly. also i’m trying to figure out badge pickup + best boba spots near the office. any tips?
Jana (People Ops): welcome Noel!! :confetti_ball: badge pick up is at reception — swing by after 10am and ask for the "New Hire Desk". we just sent an onboarding checklist to your email. ping me if you didn't get it.
Maya Chen: welcome!! :boba: for boba try Tea Alley on 8th — brown sugar taro is the move. also we do a biweekly design lunch wednesday, would love for you to join.
Luca: corgi pics or it didn't happen :dog::joy: also ukulele jam at the rooftop emoji-night next month?
Noel Kim: will bring pics asap. and ukulele sounds fun — terrible but enthusiastic :ukulele:
Sam (Design): hi Noel — super pumped to have you on the team. FYI we have a soft no-meet block on friday afternoons so folks can wrap up heads-down stuff or do get-togethers. not enforced but widely used.
Noel Kim: that no-meet block is perfect — i usually need a long stretch to get into design flow. thanks for the tip!
onboard-bot: Hi Noel, welcome to Redwood Inference! Here are quick links: Onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboard/checklist, Badge pickup hours: M-F 9am-5pm, Team lunch schedule: https://calendar.redwood.com/design-lunch.
DevEx: FYI — coffee machine on 4th floor is currently set to espresso by default. if you like drip, there's a button labelled "Filter" next to the grinder.
Maya Chen: also heads up — if you ever want to bring Pickles to the office, chat with People Ops for a quick allergy/headcount check. most people LOVE visiting dogs though :heart_eyes:
Luca: vote: first team-rooftop ukulele performance or pickles cameo? :raised_hands:
Sam (Design): both. take both. :thumbsup:
Noel Kim: sold — i'll audition Pickles and my ukulele. thanks for the warm welcome everyone :relaxed:
